project.description: The {@link ReliabilityMl.Project} for which this spec must be instantiated.

assetFilter.description: Specify the assetFilter for which inference should be run.

inferencePeriod.description:
Specify the {@link TimeRange} for which inference should be run. Note that both
`inferencePeriod.start` and `inferencePeriod.end` MUST be provided.

statusLabel.description:
Specify the statusLabel for which inference should be executed.
NOTE: Inference can only be executed for `CHAMPION` or `CHALLENGER` models.

overrideInferencePeriodForInference.description:
Flag to indicate if the inference period provided should be overriden to account for
incremental inference.

This flag should be used in {@link ReliabilityMl.Project#getInferencePeriodForAssetLambda}.

title:
Defines the specification for running an inference job within the {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator}.
This type configures parameters for executing inference on reliability assets over a specified time range.
name: ReliabilityOrchestrator.InferenceJobSpec
